correctness.rationale: For the exceptional u-free color class, the complete-bipartite induced subgraph is threshold iff ordinary-left count <=1 or all-right count <=1, giving formal EGF F. For the unique u-containing class, the usual H accounts for a=0 or total-right<=1; exactly the new configurations a=1,c=0,b>=2 yield a star plus isolated u and contribute x(e^y−1−y). Every other large pattern contains induced C4 or P4. Exponential product for q named colors with u assigned one of q choices produces the exact coefficient and deletion increment. The positivity conditions follow by placing remaining vertices in q−1 admissible classes; q=1,2,3 boundary cases are explicit. An independently implemented forbidden-induced-subgraph brute force matched integer coefficient recursion in 103 bounded (m,n,d,q) cases.
